result.topic_en: A table dated April 16 of successive oscillation readings, probably for an induction experiment, with their base-10 logarithms. Each group of four logarithms is combined into one value, and differences between the combined values (92.7 and 2408.175) are noted.

methods.what: Taking base-10 logarithms of successive oscillation readings
Combining groups of four logarithms into a single representative (mean-type) value
Difference of the combined logarithm values for two groups, used as a measure of decrement
Difference of the combined logarithm values for the second pair of groups
